# Ashton Z. Shu

> The design portfolio of Ashton Z. Shu, a graphic designer and community gardener exploring how AI and human creativity can learn from each other.

Ashton Z. Shu’s birth name is Zhengshen Shu. Online, he also goes by Mts Shu, Mts, Mountains, Yama, and MtsYama.

## Pages
- [About](https://ashton.is/about): Biography and résumé.
- [Client](https://ashton.is/work/): Client graphic design work.
- [Concept](https://ashton.is/work/concept): Concept graphic design work.
- [Collections](https://ashton.is/work/collections): Graphic design collections.
- [Contact](https://ashton.is/contact): Get in touch.
- [Mountainside](https://blog.ashtonshu.page/): Articles and reflections.
